scope: Literature, public methods and small source/metadata review; no model, benchmark, program-solution or paid execution.
decision: Withdraw original Q1 main-project recommendation; Q2 conditional discussion only; no experiment admitted.
source_policy: Primary sources; individual reading depth explicit. Absence in this search is not a novelty guarantee. Preprint status not a conference claim. Repeated URLs reflect independent readings, not distinct papers.

entries.title: Data Repetition Beats Data Scaling in Long-CoT Supervised Fine-Tuning
entries.read_depth: Read main methods and results through section 4; Appendix C termination analysis and fixed-step/token-accuracy table. Re-read in this task.
entries.evidence_boundary: Independent runs and own schedules; token accuracy is teacher-forced diagnostic, not established causal mechanism.

entries.title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT
entries.read_depth: Read sections 3-8 in this task; not every appendix proof.
entries.evidence_boundary: Batch-32/256 repetition and LiveCodeBench evidence make simple code extension/batch-1 explanation insufficient.

entries.title: Scale Dependent Data Duplication
entries.read_depth: Read sections 2, 4, 5 and Appendix B; re-read experiment limits.
entries.evidence_boundary: Semantic gradient alignment was not itself a large-model semantic-duplicate training comparison.

entries.title: Rephrasing the Web: A Recipe for Compute and Data-Efficient Language Modeling
entries.read_depth: Sections 3, 5, 6 and evaluation table controls; earlier read plus targeted revisit.

entries.title: Towards Learning (Dis)-Similarity of Source Code from Program Contrasts
entries.read_depth: Read sections 3.2 and 4 with named transformations and objective. Did not independently inspect implementation.

entries.title: Fine Until Fine-Tuned: Repeated Solutions Make Reasoning Fragile
entries.read_depth: Read main sections 2-8, Appendices K, M, N; official records/metadata inspected. Not every appendix proof independently verified.
entries.evidence_boundary: Direct D/P exposure-matched collision; fresh optimizer but same trained adapter; mechanism explicitly unresolved section 8.

entries.title: LoRA+: Efficient Low Rank Adaptation of Large Models
entries.read_depth: Read sections 3-4 role-of-factors and feature-learning analysis; no independent proof verification.
entries.evidence_boundary: Factor-specific learning rates/scale asymmetry are existing optimization science.

entries.title: LoRA Done RITE: Robust Invariant Transformation Equilibration for LoRA Optimization
entries.version: arXiv v2, 2025-07-16; ICLR 2025 proceedings also located
entries.read_depth: Read sections 2-3 including scalar invariance derivation and algorithm 1; skimmed task table/setup.
entries.evidence_boundary: Adam/SGD gauge dependence and invariant optimizer already explicit. Theoretical convergence uses stated simplifying assumptions.

entries.title: LoRA-GA: Low-Rank Adaptation with Gradient Approximation
entries.read_depth: Read section 3 gradient objective, scale stability and initialization algorithm.
entries.evidence_boundary: Function-preserving initial effective weights do not guarantee identical first-step dynamics.

entries.title: Merge before Forget: A Single LoRA Continual Learning via Continual Merging
entries.read_depth: Read sections 3-5, factor asymmetry/initialization/merging construction and benchmark/baseline table. Not appendices proofs.
entries.evidence_boundary: Continual adapter initialization and forgetting are established; its QR initialization is not our claimed function-preserving gauge control.

entries.evidence_boundary: Concentration-dependent directional curvature/forgetting is direct prior; do not present exact repeats x LoRA interaction as already answered.
